October 31, 2026 
To, 
BSE Limited 
Phiroze Jeejeebhoy Towers,  
Dalal Street, 
Mumbai 400001 
Scrip Code : 507205 
To, 
National Stock Exchange of India Limited 
Exchange Plaza, C-1, Block-G, 
Bandra-Kurla Complex, Bandra (East), 
Mumbai-400 051. 
Symbol : TI 
 
 
Sub: Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations, 2015 - Audio Recording of Earnings Conference Call held for Q2 & 
FY27 Results 
 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
With reference to our letter dated October 27, 2026 and pursuant to Regulation 30 of the 
SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we wish to 
inform you that the audio recording of the earnings conference call with analysts and 
investors held today i.e Saturday, October 31, 2026 to discuss the Q2 & FY27 results is 
available on the website of the Company at www.tilind.com and can be accessed on the 
following link: 
 
https://tilind.com/wp-content/uploads/investor/261031020439_TI%20-
%20Q2%20FY27%20-%20Audio.mp3  
 
Kindly take the above on record. 
 
Thanking you, 
 
Yours faithfully,  
 
For Tilaknagar Industries Ltd. 
 
 
 
Minuzeer Bamboat 
Company Secretary & Compliance Officer  
 
Minuzeer 
Yazdi Bamboat
Digitally signed by Minuzeer 
Yazdi Bamboat
